record.name: Boone County
record.ai_summary: Boone County Planning Commission administers zoning sign permits under the adopted zoning regulations, Article 34. Most signs require a sign permit; Section 3404 lists exemptions, and Section 3405 requires drawings of the sign and its location. Staff must check the exact zoning district, municipality, special sign district, and any separate building/electrical approvals before determining requirements.

permit_requirements.setback_requirements: Depends on the parcel's zoning district, sign type, and special sign district; check adopted Article 34 and parcel zoning.
permit_requirements.processing_time: Under adopted Section 3405, staff issues a sign permit or a notice of nonconformance within 10 working days after receiving a complete application; no automatic approval.

record.sqft_width_height_rules: Varies by zoning district, sign type, building/lot frontage, and special sign district; use adopted Article 34, Sections 3407-3408. No single countywide maximum is asserted.
record.height_allowances: Depends on sign type and applicable zoning district; check Article 34 and parcel zoning before design.
record.setback_rules: Consult Article 34 and parcel zoning, rights-of-way and easements; no single countywide setback asserted.
record.lighting_allowances: Check sign type and district under Article 34, including Section 3408.5 electronic message board/screen signs; do not assume a countywide allowance.

documents.title: Adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations — Article 34: Signs
documents.ai_summary: Adopted zoning provisions on sign exemptions, permit submissions, district and sign-type limits, electronic message signs, and special sign districts. Use adopted ordinance rather than the separate proposed 2026 rewrite.

documents.title: Article 34 §3405 — Sign permitting and review
documents.ai_summary: A sign permit is required except for the signs exempted by §3404. Applications identify applicant and owner, sign construction and illumination, lot layout, rights-of-way/easements, sign dimensions and height. Staff responds to a complete application within ten working days; silence is not an approval. Issued permits generally expire if installation has not occurred within one year.

documents.title: Boone County Planning Commission — Sign Permit Application (May 2024)
documents.ai_summary: Official five-page sign permit application. Submit completed form, fees, and three copies of drawings showing sign location, height, dimensions/area, illumination, and construction materials. Form records sign types, face changes, building and lot frontage, owner authorization and staff disposition. Planning Commission contact appears on page five.

documents.title: Planning Commission Fee Schedule — May 2021 edition (RECONFIRM FEES)
documents.ai_summary: Official county-hosted fee schedule last marked revised May 19, 2021; Section X covers sign permit review fees on page eight. This edition is older and amounts MUST be reconfirmed with the Planning Commission before quoting any job.

documents.title: Boone County GIS — Planning, zoning and special sign districts
documents.ai_summary: County Planning Commission GIS resource with zoning district and special sign district map layers. Use the actual parcel/location and its current municipality and overlays before selecting sign limits.
